long_biography.plain_text:
In 1995, Alfonso Lavarello helped return international cruising to Havana after a decades-long interruption. He became president of Milestone and co-led Silares Terminales. The mixed company developed Cuban cruise facilities under an exclusive operating concession. The project combined terminal reconstruction, commercialisation and negotiation between a state partner and international cruise operators.

Lavarello had studied in London and New York before building a career across Genoa, Miami, Monte Carlo and the Middle East. His experience with ports brought a public-infrastructure assignment. From 2023, he chaired Genoa Airport until a new board took office the following year. His mandate centred on connectivity and modernisation.
long_biography.html:
In 1995, Alfonso Lavarello helped return international cruising to Havana after a decades-long interruption. He became president of Milestone and co-led Silares Terminales. The mixed company developed Cuban cruise facilities under an exclusive operating concession. The project combined terminal reconstruction, commercialisation and negotiation between a state partner and international cruise operators.

Lavarello had studied in London and New York before building a career across Genoa, Miami, Monte Carlo and the Middle East. His experience with ports brought a public-infrastructure assignment. From 2023, he chaired Genoa Airport until a new board took office the following year. His mandate centred on connectivity and modernisation.
